summary.text: Adam Moore is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 45 who has served since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Killian Timoney. He is a U.S. Army Reserve veteran and a coach.

paragraphs.text: Adam Moore was born in Frankfort, Kentucky, and graduated from Western Hills High School.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 2007 to 2013, earned a bachelor's degree from Murray State University in 2007, and his career experience includes working as a coach.
He has been affiliated with Kentuckians for the Commonwealth, Moms Demand Action, Progress Kentucky and the Ahava Center for Spiritual Living.

Moore succeeded Republican Killian Timoney in District 45, and in the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Agriculture, House Natural Resources and Energy, Tourism and Outdoor Recreation, and House Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father, Army veteran and small business owner, and said he founded the Veterans Caucus and has made healthcare affordability a priority.
